cohort: The study included 400 mothers aged 18-40 years with diabetes and their infants at a Maternity and Children Hospital in Saudi Arabia.
finding: The study found that most women with gestational diabetes were multiparous and often had previous DM diagnoses, with Caesarean delivery being dominant, and while maternal complications were present in less than one-third, neonatal complications affected 12.5% of infants.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was found to be the dominant mode of birth among the mothers studied.
